name: FreshBooks API
tagline: Invoicing, time tracking, and accounting API for freelancers and small service businesses.
description: REST API for FreshBooks accounting software. Create and send invoices, track time and expenses, manage clients and projects, handle payments, and sync accounting data. OAuth2-based with bearer tokens. Popular with freelancers, agencies, and service businesses automating billing workflows.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Register an app at my.freshbooks.com/developers, obtain client_id and client_secret. Exchange code for access_token; call API with Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN. Also supports identity/me for account resolution.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access included with FreshBooks plans; free trial available. No per-request API pricing published; subject to account plan limits.
pricing.paid_plans: Tied to FreshBooks subscription (Lite, Plus, Premium, Select). See freshbooks.com/pricing.

use_cases: create and send an invoice to a client
list unpaid invoices for a business account
log billable time entries against a project
create or update a client contact
record an expense with category and amount
fetch account identity and business memberships
